slides.title: Land Cruisers in a suit: the years to buy.
slides.body: Every LX is built on the Land Cruiser of its day, and every GX on the Prado. Swipe for the year to look for, and the ones to check twice.
The 2003 facelift brought the five-speed automatic. Forum regulars call 2003–05 the years to get. Check the steering-shaft recall.

slides.title: Careful with 2008–10.
slides.body: Most of the radiator-crack reports come from these years, and owners say 2008s had water-pump issues. After that it's taste.

slides.credit: Prado 120, the GX 470’s twin · Seek liam, CC BY-SA 4.0
slides.title: Buy on condition.
slides.body: It’s a Prado 120 underneath. Same 2UZ-FE V8 and five-speed in every year, so rust, timing-belt records and the air suspension matter more than the build date.

slides.credit: Prado 150, the GX 460’s twin · Ajay Lamichhane / Pexels
slides.title: 2014 and later.
slides.body: Air-pump failures are a known 2010–13 problem. On an early truck, confirm the updated parts went in.

end.eyebrow: Save this for when you're shopping
end.title: Every LX and GX, year by year.
end.body: The years to buy, the ones to avoid and the recalls to check, in our Lexus guide.
